abilities.name: Live for the Swarm!
abilities.text: When this Unit attacks an Enemy Unit with the INFESTATION Status or a Unit Within 6″ of any Source of Creep or Creep Tumor, its Infested C-14 Rifle and all Close Combat Attacks gain PRECISION (2).

abilities.name: Detonation
abilities.text: Immediately before any models in this Unit are Destroyed, Enemy Units Within 2″ suffer HITS 1 (2) for each model in this Unit that will be Destroyed.

abilities.name: Spread Infestation
abilities.text: Target an Enemy Unit Within 8″. The targeted Unit gains the INFESTATION Status. For the purposes of resolving Special Abilities, this effect is treated as a DEBUFF.

abilities.name: Burrow Ambush
abilities.text: When this Unit is nominated to deploy from the Reserves, it may resolve the PLACE (18) effect from the controlling player's Entry Edge. No model may be set Within 10″ of any Enemy model. This Unit's Activation ends.

abilities.name: Plagued Munitions
abilities.text: Immediately after an attack with the Infested C-14 Rifle, if the attacked Unit suffered Damage, it also suffers NON-LETHAL DAMAGE (1).

abilities.name: Devastating Charge
abilities.text: Immediately after this Unit completes a successful Charge, resolve the IMPACT (2) 4+ effect.
